extraction.Name: William Titbits
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee but took it on the advice of the Farmer and the Agency authorities for he was told that if he did not take it and pay the taxes that he would lose the land
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold it to Hex Livermont of Cody, Nebr. for $35.00 per acre
extraction.Buyer: Hex Livermont of Cody, Nebr. for $35.00 per acre, which is a fair price for the land
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes on his land so he sold it
extraction.Age: 48 years old (document also states 46 years old in a second reference)
extraction.Occupation/Income: makes a living by common labor, but that he makes very little, about $200.00 per year
extraction.NOTES: Document contains conflicting age statements: first states 48 years old, later states 46 years old. Mentally competent; in poor health, suffering with rheumatism; has no land or home and lives on the allotment of his son, which is poor land; has nine children and a wife to support; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since he was granted a patent. Affidavit subscribed and sworn November 28, 1928. | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County (Pine Ridge area, South Dakota)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
